game_title: Divide Or Floor – Sulfur Springs Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split ash bricks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split ash bricks evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round, ember hounds strike the fire shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the share value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the fire shrine from ember hounds in Sulfur Springs: keep the share meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: share drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Sulfur Springs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while share > 0.
